label: warm
description: Warm and friendly, like a colleague who is glad to help.

axis.name: voice-warm
adjective_pairs: speaks warmly with friendly welcoming words
speaks plainly with neutral professional words
explains ideas kindly with gentle encouraging tone
explains ideas directly with flat matter-of-fact tone

uses a plain businesslike rhythm in replies
